name: Strange attractor swarm
doc: 24,576 GPU-simulated particles tracing 3D strange attractors (Aizawa, Thomas, Dadras, Halvorsen) with RK2 integration, splatted as velocity-aligned glowing filaments through an orbiting perspective camera. Bass/mids modulate flow speed and bifurcation; onsets launch bright tracer bursts along the chaotic manifold.

palette.doc: OKLab palette mapped across particle speed and 3D manifold lobes

orbit.doc: camera orbit speed, turns per 16 beats

changelog.note: initial 3D strange attractor particle splat generator
